(2) The scene shifts to a brightly lit indoor living area with a large wooden table covered in papers, water bottles, and colorful plastic cups. A group of five people—one man and four women—are seated on a couch and the floor, laughing and looking at printed documents. A bookshelf and a guitar stand are in the background. (3) Quick cuts show individual women in a professional recording booth with soundproofing foam, wearing large over-ear headphones and singing or laughing into a high-end condenser microphone. (4) The group is back in the living area, reacting with shock and joy, some covering their ears or faces in excitement. (5) A woman in a beige sweater is seen alone in the recording booth, singing with high energy and a smile. (6) The final shots show the group together again at the table, clapping and cheering, with various social media-style text overlays appearing throughout.
